Package paint.shared.config

Class TrackMateConfig

java.lang.Object
paint.shared.config.TrackMateConfig
public class TrackMateConfig extends Object
The TrackMateConfig class represents configuration parameters used in a tracking system. It encapsulates various settings related to frame gap, localization techniques, distance thresholds, and track management functionalities like merging and splitting.

This class is immutable as all properties are final and set through constructors. This allows for thread-safe usage and ensures the configuration data remains consistent throughout the application.

Key capabilities:

  • Specification of tracking parameters such as maximum frame gap, linking costs, maximum allowed distances for linking, gap closing, splitting, and merging.
  • Enabling or disabling specific track behaviors such as subpixel localization, track merging, splitting, and gap closing.
  • Setting constraints on track construction, including minimum spots per track, maximum spots in an image, and other related parameters.
  • Configuration of optional operations such as median filtering.
  • Provides a utility method to write the configuration to a file in a structured string form.

    • isDeterministicTracking

      public boolean isDeterministicTracking()
      Whether TrackMate links spots on a single thread.

      With several threads (the default), TrackMate's linking is not reproducible: the same recording with the same settings can give slightly different tracks from run to run. On a single thread the result is reproducible, but linking is considerably slower. See doc/Change Note - TrackMate Determinism and Single Detection.md.

      Returns:
      true to link on a single thread (default false, all threads)

    • isExcludeEdgeTracks

      public boolean isExcludeEdgeTracks()
      Whether tracks present in the first or the last analysed frame are excluded.

      For such a track the real duration is unknown: it may have started before the recording began, or continued after it ended. Its measured duration is only a lower bound, which would bias durations, and therefore Tau, towards shorter values. Excluded tracks are not written to the tracks file and are not counted or drawn. See doc/Change Note - Exclude Edge Tracks.md.

      Returns:
      true to exclude edge tracks (default true, also when the key is absent)
